# Insurance Region (VIN) Query

## Use Cases

- **Used car valuation and condition verification**: judge vehicle usage years and information consistency by combining first registration date and insurance time.
- **Insurance underwriting and renewal**: assess underwriting, renewal, and client-reach opportunities based on insured region and latest insurance month.
- **Vehicle regional risk analysis**: analyze vehicle distribution, accident risk, and insurance demand across provinces, cities, and districts.
- **Owner operations and marketing**: conduct reminders, quoting, and value-added service recommendations for clients nearing renewal.
- **Vehicle finance and risk-control review**: assist in confirming base vehicle information and insurance coverage continuity.
- **Sales flow analysis**: OEM sales flow analysis.

## Endpoint

`POST /api/v1/getVehInsuranceRegion`

See the cooperation email notification for the endpoint.

## Request Parameters



Request headers: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.

```json
{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN000001"}
```

The request body only allows `vin`, which must be a 17-character VIN; do not mix in a license plate or other fields.

## Response Fields

### Common Response Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | Business status code: `0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` parameter format error, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Not used when the authentication layer rejects. |
| message | string | Business processing result description, returned by the service on success, no-data, or failure. |
| data | object/array/null | Business result. An object or array on success; usually null on no-data or business failure. |
| request_id | string | Request trace ID for troubleshooting; do not use it as a substitute for a key or token. |

### `data[]` Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| province | string/null | Province of the insurance. |
| city | string/null | City of the insurance. |
| county | string/null | District/county of the insurance. |
| insuranceMonth | string/null | Latest insurance year-month; usually `YYYY-MM`, subject to the actual value. |
| vin | string/null | VIN of the associated vehicle. |
| registerDate | string/null | Vehicle registration / first registration date; format from upstream. |

`data` is an array; it is `null` when there is no matching data. Missing business fields in a single record return `null`; the response does not include the license plate.

## Examples

### Free Test Case

Uses the current Swagger default input: `vin=1HGBH41JXMN000001`.

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://<API_HOST>/api/v1/getVehInsuranceRegion" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN000001"}'
```

### Success Response

The following is the field-structure example based on the default test input; region, month, and date are for illustration only, and the actual result is subject to the interface response.

```json
{
  "code":"0000",
  "message":"成功",
  "data":[{
    "province":"江苏省",
    "city":"南京市",
    "county":"鼓楼区",
    "insuranceMonth":"2026-06",
    "vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****",
    "registerDate":"2020-01-01"
  }],
  "request_id":"request-id"
}
```

Fields may be `null`.

## Error Codes

### VIN Format Error (HTTP 400)

```json
{"code":"4001","message":"VIN格式不正确","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### No Data (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"0001","message":"查无数据","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### Supplier Format Error or Vehicle Mismatch (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商返回格式不正确","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商返回车辆与查询条件不匹配","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### Token or Service Failure (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"5002","message":"供应商Token获取失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商接口调用失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

Authentication-layer errors are handled as HTTP `401`, `403`, `429`, `503` and do not use the above business codes.

# Claims Report - InsuranceReportByVIN

## Use Cases

- **Deep used car condition verification**: obtain relatively complete insurance and claims records by VIN to support acquisition decisions.
- **Accident risk and price assessment**: combine loss amount, accident type, and repair clues for pricing and grading.
- **Insurance review and anti-fraud**: verify case status, claim count, and abnormal flags to assist risk judgment.
- **Report delivery and customer communication**: used for condition disclosure, transaction explanation, and after-sales dispute records.

## Endpoint

See the cooperation email notification.

## Request Parameters

### Request Method

POST

### Request Parameters

| Parameter    | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | ---- | ---------- |
| access_token | String | Yes  | Access token |
| vin          | String | Yes  | Vehicle identification number |
| notify_url   | String | Yes  | Publicly accessible callback URL |
| req_img      | String | Yes  | Driving license image URL |
| plate_num    | String | No   | License plate number (recommended) |
| engine_num   | String | No   | Engine number |

## Response Fields

### Synchronous Response Result

{ "ret": 200, "data": { "orderNum": "735790323510**5**0" }, "msg": "" }

orderNum // Query order number

### Async Notification Field Structure

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| orderReportVehicle | Object | Vehicle base information |
| orderReportVehicleModel | Object | Model information |
| orderReportVehicleExactInsurance | Object | Precise claim information |
| orderReportExtend | Object | Report extension information (contains PDF and JPG report links) |

## Examples

### Async Notification Example

Example

{ "orderReportVehicle":{// Vehicle base information
 "vin":"LBV61AF09PSB66xxx",// VIN
 "plateNum":"",// License plate number
 "engineNum":"",// Engine number
 "suppliers":[12],// Product code set
 "is_true":true,// true: has data; false: no data
 "orderNum":"20250723262454125**3"// Order number
 },
 "orderReportVehicleModel":{// Model information
 "brand":"",// Brand
 "series":"",// Series
 "is_true":""// true: has data; false: no data
 },
 "orderReportVehicleExactInsurance":{// Precise claim information
 "is_true":1,// Flag: 1 = purchased with data; 2 = purchased, query no data; 3 = not purchased; 4 = purchase failed
 "data":[{// Repair information
 "VehicleInfo":{// Vehicle information
 "FirstRegDate":"1-2年",// Production date
 "IsBusinessRecord":"否",// Whether there are business records
 "DriverNumber":"1任",// Number of owners
 "UseNatureCode":"非营业企业",// Current usage type
 "IsNotOwn":"是",// Whether there is a non-individual owner
 "OwnerType":"个人"// Current owner type
 },
 "InsuranceInfo":{// Insurance information
 "IsEffectiveCMI":"是",// Current commercial auto insurance validity
 "LargeAmount":"5000",// Largest loss amount
 "RecordicPending":"否",// Unclosed insurance case record (yes/no)
 "IsWaterflooded":"否",// Whether flooded
 "Inscompensation":"否",// Insurance claim denial record (yes/no)
 "RecordIWriteoff":"否",// Insurance case cancellation record (yes/no)
 "CpiDangTimes":"0",// Compulsory insurance claim count
 "CmiDangTimes":"1",// Commercial auto insurance claim count
 "IsSeriescoverCPI":"多张保单连续投保",// Compulsory insurance continuity
 "IsRobber":"否",// Whether theft/robbery occurred
 "IsEffectiveCPI":"是",// Current compulsory insurance validity
 "IsBurned":"否"// Whether burned
 },
 "ClaimDetail":[{// Claim information
 "LossoccurDate":"2024年二季度",// Claim time
 "LossPart":"喷漆:右后视镜上壳,喷漆:右前翼子板,喷漆:右后翼子板,保险杠,喷漆:右前车门",// Loss part
 "VehicleLossAmount":"5000",// Vehicle loss amount
 "IsRobber":"否",// Whether theft/robbery
 "ClaimType":"商业险",// Claim type
 "IsBurned":"否",// Whether burned
 "IsWaterflooded":"否",// Whether flooded
 "ClaimStatus":"已结案，结案金额大于0"// Case status
 }]
 }]
 },
 "orderReportExtend":{// Report extension information
 "is_true":false,// false when empty; true when it has content
 "orderReportUrl1":"",// Claim report in PDF generated from existing content
 "orderReportUrl2":"",// Claim report in JPG generated from existing content
 "orderReportUrl3":""// Claim report in HTML generated from existing content
 } }

## Error Codes

### Error Code List

| Error Code (ret) | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Error, usually parameter validation failure, invalid VIN format, abnormal request, etc. |
| 404 | No data found |



---

### Async Notification Description

The async notification pushes a JSON payload to the callback URL provided in the request. After processing the notification, output `1` to confirm receipt.

Normally it completes within about 20 seconds. Obtain the downstream client's success response;

otherwise it re-pushes every 3 minutes, up to 12 times.

### `orderReportVehicle` Structure

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vin | String | VIN |
| plateNum | String | License plate number |
| engineNum | String | Engine number |
| orderNum | String | Order number |
| suppliers | Array | Product code set |
| is_true | Boolean | true: has data; false: no data |

### `orderReportVehicleModel` Structure

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| brand | String | Brand |
| series | String | Series |
| is_true | Boolean | true: has data; false: no data |

### `orderReportVehicleExactInsurance` Structure

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| data | Array | Repair information |
| is_true | Byte | Flag: 1 = purchased with data; 2 = purchased, query no data; 3 = not purchased; 4 = purchase failed |

#### `Data.InsuranceInfo` Structure

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| IsEffectiveCPI | Current compulsory insurance validity |
| IsEffectiveCMI | Current commercial auto insurance validity |
| IsRobber | Whether theft/robbery occurred |
| IsBurned | Whether burned |
| IsWaterflooded | Whether flooded |
| IsSeriescoverCDR | Vehicle damage insurance continuity |
| IsSeriescoverCPI | Compulsory insurance continuity |
| IsEffectiveTPL | Current third-party liability insurance validity |
| IsEffectiveMVL | Current motor vehicle loss insurance validity |
| IsCoverageMVL | Current vehicle damage coverage amount |
| CpiDangTimes | Compulsory insurance claim count |
| CmiDangTimes | Commercial auto insurance claim count |
| LargeAmount | Largest loss amount |
| LargeClaims | Large claim (yes/no) |
| RecordicPending | Unclosed insurance case record (yes/no) |
| RecordIWriteoff | Insurance case cancellation record (yes/no) |
| Inscompensation | Insurance claim denial record (yes/no) |

#### `Data.VehicleInfo` Structure

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| FirstRegDate | First registration date |
| BodyColor | Body color |
| CarCategory | Vehicle category |
| DriverNumber | Number of owners |
| OwnerType | Current owner type |
| UseNatureCode | Current usage type |
| engineNum | Engine number |
| EmissionStandards | Emission standard |
| ProductionDate | Production date |
| IsBusinessRecord | Whether there are business records |
| VIN | VIN |
| plateNum | License plate number |
| plateType | Plate type code (see code table) |
| VehicleCategory | Category attribute |
| ReplacementValue | New car purchase price |
| Brand | Brand name |
| vehicleType | Vehicle type (see code table) |
| VehicleDisplacement | Displacement |
| ModelName | Trim name |
| RatedPasscapa | Rated seating capacity |
| IsNotOwn | Whether there is a non-individual owner |

#### `Data.ClaimDetail` Structure

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ClaimStatus | Case status |
| LossoccurDate | Claim time |
| ClaimType | Claim type |
| OptionCause | Accident cause |
| AccidentLiab | Accident liability assignment |
| VehicleLossAmount | Vehicle loss amount |
| IsRobber | Whether theft/robbery |
| IsBurned | Whether burned |
| IsWaterflooded | Whether flooded |
| LossPart | Loss part |

### `orderReportExtend` Structure

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| is_true | Boolean | true: has data; false: no data |
| orderReportUrl1 | String | Formatted HTML report generated from the text JSON; has content immediately after the callback is received |
| orderReportUrl2 | String | AI-extracted risk summary report generated later; because AI generation takes time, it usually has content about 5 minutes after the callback |
| orderReportUrl3 | String | Empty, reserved field |

Notes

The AI-extracted risk summary report is a test giveaway; it may be removed later due to policy or technical reasons.

# Insurance Transfer Count (License Plate) Query

## Use Cases

- **Used car valuation and transaction decisions**: judge vehicle transfer frequency to assist pricing, acquisition, and sale.
- **Condition and risk verification**: identify potential risks such as frequent transfers and short-term flipping.
- **Insurance and finance review**: assist insurance underwriting, auto-loan approval, and risk assessment.

## Endpoint

`POST /api/v1/getInsTransferCountbyPlate`

See the cooperation email notification for the endpoint.

## Request Parameters

### Request

Request headers: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.

```json
{"licensePlate":"京A00000"}
```

The request body only allows `licensePlate`. The service trims surrounding whitespace, uppercases Latin letters, and validates against ordinary and new-energy plate rules.

## Response Fields

### Common Response Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | Business status code: `0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` parameter format error, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Not used when the authentication layer rejects. |
| message | string | Business processing result description, returned by the service on success, no-data, or failure. |
| data | object/array/null | Business result. An object or array on success; usually null on no-data or business failure. |
| request_id | string | Request trace ID for troubleshooting; do not use it as a substitute for a key or token. |

### `data` Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| plate | string | The license plate returned and verified to match the query plate. |
| totalTransCount | string | Cumulative insurance transfer count; `"0"` is a valid result. |
| latestTransYM | string/null | Year-month of the latest insurance transfer; null when no record. |
| transCarYear | string/null | Vehicle age at the latest transfer; null when no record. |

## Examples

### Free Test Case

Uses the current Swagger default input: `licensePlate=京A00000`.

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://<API_HOST>/api/v1/getInsTransferCountbyPlate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"licensePlate":"京A00000"}'
```

### Success Response

The following is the field-structure example based on the default test input; count, year-month, and age are for illustration only, and the actual result is subject to the interface response.

```json
{
  "code":"0000",
  "message":"成功",
  "data":{
    "plate":"京A00000",
    "totalTransCount":"0",
    "latestTransYM":null,
    "transCarYear":null
  },
  "request_id":"request-id"
}
```

## Error Codes

### License Plate Format Error (HTTP 400)

```json
{"code":"4001","message":"车牌格式不正确","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### No Data, Service Failure, and Token Failure (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"0001","message":"查无数据","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商接口调用失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5002","message":"供应商Token获取失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

Authentication-layer errors are HTTP `401`, `403`, `429`, `503` and do not use business codes.

# Largest Claim Query

## Use Cases

- **Used car valuation and transaction decisions**
    - Judge the severity of a vehicle's major accident, repair scope, and depreciation.
    - Support pricing, acquisition, replacement, and condition disclosure.
- **Insurance underwriting and renewal**
    - Assess the vehicle's historical risk, claim frequency, and potential payout risk.
    - Assist in premium pricing, coverage restrictions, and renewal review.
- **Fleet and corporate vehicle management**
    - Monitor major accidents, repair costs, and downtime impact of operating vehicles.
    - Support vehicle retirement, replacement, and driving-safety management.


## Endpoint

`POST /api/v1/getVehMaxClaimIncident`
See the cooperation email notification for the endpoint.

## Request Parameters

### Request

Request headers: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.

```json
{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN000001"}
```

`vin` is required and must be a 17-character VIN. Do not add other fields to the request body.

## Response Fields

### Common Response Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | Business status code: `0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` parameter format error, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Not used when the authentication layer rejects. |
| message | string | Business processing result description, returned by the service on success, no-data, or failure. |
| data | object/array/null | Business result. An object or array on success; usually null on no-data or business failure. |
| request_id | string | Request trace ID for troubleshooting; do not use it as a substitute for a key or token. |

### `data` Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vin | string | The VIN of the queried vehicle. |
| insuranceType | any/null | Insurance type and insured object, e.g., "商业险,主车" (commercial auto insurance, primary vehicle); passed through from upstream, non-closed enum. |
| accidentTime | any/null | Time of the largest claim; format determined by upstream data. |
| accidentRegion | any/null | Region where the largest claim occurred. |
| vehicleDamageAmount | any/null | Vehicle loss amount. |
| personInjuryAmount | any/null | Personal injury amount. |
| repairAgency | any/null | Repair agency name. |
| partsGroups | array | List of damaged parts grouped by repair operation; empty array when no parts. |
| lossPart | any/null | Loss-part summary; usually comma-separated text, passed through from upstream. |

### `partsGroups[].parts[]` Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| operation | any/null | Repair operation, e.g., "更换" (replace); passed through from upstream, non-closed enum. |
| parts | array | The list of parts for the operation. |
| parts[].partIdentifier | any/null | Part name or part identifier. |
| parts[].type | any/null | Part type code/name; passed through from upstream, non-closed enum. |
| parts[].lossPartIdentifier | any/null | Part loss location or identifier. |
| parts[].flag | any/null | Supplier part additional flag. |

## Examples

### Free Test Case

Uses the current Swagger default input: `vin=1HGBH41JXMN000001`.

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://<API_HOST>/api/v1/getVehMaxClaimIncident" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN000001"}'
```

### Success Response

The following is the field-structure example based on the default test input; accident, amount, and part values are for illustration only, and the actual result is subject to the interface response.

```json
{
  "code":"0000",
  "message":"成功",
  "data":{
    "vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****",
    "insuranceType":"商业险,主车",
    "accidentTime":"2019-01",
    "accidentRegion":"天津市津南区***",
    "vehicleDamageAmount":162337.0,
    "personInjuryAmount":5000.0,
    "repairAgency":"天津悦诚****公司",
    "partsGroups":[{"operation":"更换","parts":[{"partIdentifier":"仪表台扬声器（左）","type":1,"lossPartIdentifier":"内部","flag":""}]}],
    "lossPart":"内部,正前,底部,左前,顶部,右侧,左侧"
  },
  "request_id":"request-id"
}
```

`partsGroups` is always an array; part items may contain `partIdentifier`, `type`, `lossPartIdentifier`, and `flag`, with missing values as `null`.

## Error Codes

### Business Codes & Notes

`0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` incorrect parameter, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Authentication-layer errors are handled per the common authentication documentation, and `request_id` is retained.

### VIN Format Error (HTTP 400)

Request: `{"vin":"INVALID"}`

```json
{"code":"4001","message":"VIN格式不正确","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### No Data (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"0001","message":"查无数据","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### Service or Supplier Token Failure (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商接口调用失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5002","message":"供应商Token获取失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

Authentication failure, no path permission, rate limiting, and unavailable authentication dependencies return HTTP `401`, `403`, `429`, `503` without using the above business codes.

# Operating Vehicle Weekly Sales

## Use Cases

- Track new operating-vehicle additions and brand/type changes on a weekly basis.
- Analyze vehicle structure by emission standard, fuel type, horsepower range, and drive form.
- Locate the regional distribution and incremental market of operating vehicles (passenger transport, hazardous goods, and heavy-duty) by province, city, and district.
- Support commercial vehicle sales, operating-fleet management, regional deployment, and policy-effect assessment.

## Data Fields



```json
{
  "week": "string",
  "brand": "string",
  "vehicle_type": "string",
  "emission_standard": "string",
  "fuel_type": "string",
  "horsepower_range": "string",
  "drive_form": "string",
  "province": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "district": "string",
  "engine_model": "string",
  "vehicle_model": "string",
  "vehicle_count": "integer"
}
```

## Data Sample

The following is a spreadsheet-style display of the first 5 records of the source file.

| week         | brand    | vehicle_type | emission_standard | fuel_type | horsepower_range       | drive_form | province   | city   | vehicle_model               | vehicle_count |
| ------------ | ----- | ---- | ---- | ---- | --------- | ---- | --- | --- | ------------------ | --- |

# Owner Consistency Verification — Compulsory and Commercial Auto Insurance Separately

## Use Cases

- **Used car transaction verification**: verify the consistency between the vehicle and its current owner using VIN, owner ID number, and insurance information.
- **Mobility and freight platform review**: judge whether the compulsory and commercial auto insurance policyholder or owner information matches, reducing identity-impersonation risk.
- **Vehicle finance risk control**: assist auto loans and financial leases in verifying vehicle ownership and insurance status.
- **OEM used-car trade-in subsidy policy verification**: verify the authenticity of trade-in subsidy policies launched by OEMs in new-car marketing.



## Endpoint

`POST /api/v1/verifyVehOwnerConsistency`

See the cooperation email notification for the endpoint.

## Request Parameters

### Request

Request headers: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.

```json
{
  "vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****",
  "idCard":"<ID_CARD>",
  "licensePlate":""
}
```

`vin` is a 17-character VIN; `idCard` is required and 18 characters; `licensePlate` is optional and supports 7- or 8-character ordinary/new-energy plates. The service trims surrounding whitespace and normalizes letters.

## Response Fields

### Common Response Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | Business status code: `0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` parameter format error, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Not used when the authentication layer rejects. |
| message | string | Business processing result description, returned by the service on success, no-data, or failure. |
| data | object/array/null | Business result. An object or array on success; usually null on no-data or business failure. |
| request_id | string | Request trace ID for troubleshooting; do not use it as a substitute for a key or token. |

### `data` Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vin | string | The VIN of the queried vehicle. |
| ownerConsistency | string | Owner consistency verification result; usually text containing "商业险:是/否、交强险:是/否" (commercial: yes/no, compulsory: yes/no); passed through from upstream, non-closed enum. |

## Examples

### Free Test Case

Uses the current Swagger default input. This ID number is only a docs example; replace it with authorized test data.

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://<API_HOST>/api/v1/verifyVehOwnerConsistency" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****","idCard":"<ID_CARD>","licensePlate":""}'
```

### Success Response

The following is the field-structure example based on the default test input; the consistency result is for illustration only, and the actual result is subject to the interface response.

```json
{
  "code":"0000",
  "message":"成功",
  "data":{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****","ownerConsistency":"商业险:否,交强险:否"},
  "request_id":"request-id"
}
```

ID numbers are sensitive data and must only be transmitted on the client's controlled server side; do not write them into logs, tickets, or screenshots.

## Error Codes

### Business Codes & Notes

`0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` input format incorrect, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Authentication-layer errors are handled as `401`, `403`, `429`, `503`.

### ID Number Length Error (HTTP 422)

Request: `{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****","idCard":"123","licensePlate":""}`

```json
{"code":"invalid_request","message":"request validation failed","request_id":"request-id"}
```

### No Data or Supplier Failure (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"0001","message":"查无数据","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商接口调用失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5002","message":"供应商Token获取失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

Authentication failure, no path permission, rate limiting, and unavailable authentication dependencies are HTTP `401`, `403`, `429`, `503`.

# Passenger Vehicle Model Library

## Use Cases

- The passenger vehicle model library is a structured model-data platform covering sedans, SUVs, MPVs, and sports cars, including conventional fuel and new-energy passenger vehicles.
- It is organized along the brand / series / model year / trim mainline, associating OEM MSRP, powertrain form, body dimensions, seat count, range, energy consumption, configuration parameters, and images.
- Combined with the MIIT automotive product announcements, model application information, and on-market data, it forms a complete profile from eligibility model to consumer model.
- It supports filtering and side-by-side comparison by brand, class, price range, energy type, range, drive type, and seat count.
- The data must be continuously maintained for discontinued, facelifted, generation-changed, newly added, and price-adjusted statuses to ensure timeliness and traceability.

- For consumers: quickly find the target model, compare configurations and powertrain versions, and lower selection and price-comparison costs.
- For sales and dealerships: uniformly present model selling points, parameters, and competitor comparisons to improve lead conversion and sales communication.
- For content and media: provide a standardized, searchable data foundation for buying guides, reviews, model comparisons, and market reports.
- For used car, finance, and insurance: assist in identifying the specific model version and verifying base parameters, and support valuation, risk control, and quoting.
- For industry research: track brand product layouts, NEV penetration, price-band competition, and segment changes to inform product and business decisions.

---

# Passenger Vehicle Monthly Sales

## Use Cases

- Monthly passenger vehicle sales based on first-time compulsory-insurance registrations: the number of new vehicles insured for compulsory insurance for the first time, aggregated by month and mapped to brand, series, trim, and energy type via VIN.
- It is closer to vehicles actually entering use and end-delivery, so it is often used to observe retail demand; strictly speaking, however, it is neither the automaker's factory-gate sales nor the narrow retail caliber used by institutions such as the CPCA.
- Statistics must be limited to "first-time new-vehicle insurance" and exclude renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and duplicate records, and ensure correct vehicle-type attribution (passenger vs. commercial); otherwise monthly new-vehicle sales will be overestimated.
- The insured region reflects the region associated with the policy or vehicle registration and does not necessarily equal the consumer's long-term usage location; cross-region purchasing and out-of-area registration affect regional market judgment.
- Aggregated statistics only; no personal information.



- Market monitoring: track monthly passenger vehicle totals, fuel vs. new-energy vehicles, and terminal performance by brand and series to identify demand turning points and seasonality earlier.
- Competitor analysis: compare regional sales, growth, and share of same-class, same-price-band, or same-powertrain models to inform product positioning, marketing rhythm, and model planning.
- Regional operations: identify the true insured-registration distribution by province, city, or city cluster to support dealer network layout, channel target breakdown, and marketing and inventory resource allocation.
- New model assessment: observe monthly insured-registration ramp, regional penetration, and configuration structure after a new model launch to assess product acceptance and promotion effectiveness.
- Supply chain and business forecasting: combine insured-registration trends with wholesale, orders, inventory, and delivery cycles to support production/sales forecasting and reduce inventory misjudgment from wholesale data alone.
- Finance and insurance research: under compliance, provide model-level demand evidence for residual value assessment, risk pricing, parc estimation, and after-sales service network planning.
- Data product building: combined with MIIT announcements, the passenger vehicle model library, MSRP, and configuration data, more dimensional analytical frameworks can be formed.



## Data Field Example

```json
[
    {
        "year_month": 202402,
        "city": "广州市",
        "province": "广东省",
        "domestic_imported": "Domestic",
        "manufacturer": "小鹏汽车",
        "brand": "小鹏",
        "series": "小鹏X9",
        "fuel_type": "BEV",
        "sales": 19,
        "body_type": "MPV",
        "vehicle_class": "Full-size MPV",
        "vehicle_category": "MPV",
        "displacement_l": "0.0L",
        "transmission": "1AT",
        "emission_standard": "Zero-emission",
        "drive_type": "AWD",
        "usage_type": "Non-operational",
        "ownership": "Corporate",
        "city_tier": "Tier 1",
        "brand_tier": "Mid-high",
        "brand_origin": "Domestic"
    }
]
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

# Person-Vehicle Verification

## Use Cases

- **Auto finance credit review**: verify the association between the applicant, the vehicle, and the business documents.
- **Financial lease and pledge management**: assist in confirming the vehicle user or related entity to reduce ownership and fraud risk.
- **Insurance and claims document verification**: verify the person-vehicle relationship during underwriting, changes, and claims.
- **Used car transaction review**: provide auxiliary verification for transfers, replacements, and high-value vehicle transactions.

## Endpoint

See the cooperation email notification.

## API Description

| Protocol | Method | Encoding | Response Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HTTPS | GET/POST | UTF-8 | JSON |


## Input Parameters
VIN (or license plate number) + name or enterprise name

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| access_token | string | Optional | Access token; only required when signature verification is enabled. Generate it via the App.Auth.ApplyToken interface |
| ownerName | string | Yes | Owner name or entity name |
| plateNum | string | Optional | License plate number (either plate or VIN is required; when both are passed, VIN takes priority) |
| vin | string | Optional | VIN (either plate or VIN is required; when both are passed, VIN takes priority) |

ownerName+plateNum

or

ownerName+vin

Choose either combination.

Generally, ownerName+vin has a higher hit rate.

## Response Fields

### Response Result

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ret | integer | Status code; 200 = success, 4xx = client error, 5xx = server error |
| data | object or mixed type | Business data, specified per interface; usually an object |
| msg | string | Message; error description on failure |

Sample JSON response

```text
// Successful query example, consistent
{
    "ret": 200,
    "data": {
        "checkResult": 1
    },
    "msg": ""
}

// Successful query example, inconsistent
{
    "ret": 200,
    "data": {
        "checkResult": 2
    },
    "msg": ""
}

// Failed query example, parameter error
{
    "ret": 400,
    "data": {},
    "msg": "车牌号码不正确或超出服务范围"
}

// Failed query example, no data
{
    "ret": 414,
    "data": {},
    "msg": "查无数据"
}
```

## Error Codes

### Error List

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | ret=400, client parameter error or invalid request |
| 404 | ret=404, the interface service does not exist |
| 406 | ret=406, access_token verification failed |
| 407 | ret=407, insufficient app_key permission or unknown application |
| 408 | ret=408, the current user is prohibited or not logged in |
| 414 | ret=414, no data found |
| 500 | Internal server error |



### Important Technical FAQ

If the owner and the insured person are inconsistent — this often occurs with company-registered vehicles.

After actual verification, the actual owner is used.

# Power BI Custom Development

> Data analytics services for automotive clients | From Excel to AI-assisted decisions, one-stop

---

## Service Overview

We provide **Power BI + AI data analytics services** that turn data scattered across Excel, business systems, and databases into analytics dashboards that are **easy to read, drill down, export, and alert on**, and use AI to quickly locate problems and uncover opportunities.

**Core philosophy**: we do not overturn the client's existing Excel habits; instead we make data capabilities connect seamlessly and upgrade step by step.

---

## Six Service Capabilities

| # | Capability | What We Do | What the Client Gets |
|---|------|-----------|-------------|
| 1 | **Data Cleaning** | Multi-source ingestion (Excel/database/API/cloud), deduplication, missing/outlier handling, caliber standardization, automated pipelines | A clean, trustworthy, reusable data foundation |
| 2 | **Data Modeling** | Star schemas, dimensional modeling, a DAX measure system, relationship and permission design | Unified calibers; reports and AI share the same source and accuracy |
| 3 | **Data Analysis** | Multidimensional analysis, YoY/MoM, forecasting, attribution, anomaly detection | From "seeing data" to "finding answers" |
| 4 | **Visualization** | Cockpits/large screens/mobile, themed design, smart narratives | See the business at a glance |
| 5 | **Easy Export** | One-click PDF/PPT/Excel export, subscription distribution, embed and share | Reports reach decision-makers directly, no more manual copy-paste |
| 6 | **Excel Collaboration** | Direct Excel connection, Power Query/Pivot reuse, post-export processing, add-ins | Reuse familiar tools for a smooth transition |

---

## Service Process

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Requirements Interview] --> B[Data Ingestion & Cleaning]
    B --> C[Data Modeling]
    C --> D[Dashboards & AI Q&A]
    D --> E[Export & Collaboration]
    E --> F[Training & Iteration]
```

1. **Requirements interview**: clarify business questions and key metrics (sales, penetration, gross margin, inventory, etc.).
2. **Data ingestion & cleaning**: ingest from the client's existing Excel/systems/databases and normalize.
3. **Data modeling**: build star schemas and unified metric calibers.
4. **Dashboards & AI Q&A**: visual dashboards + natural-language Q&A + anomaly alerts.
5. **Export & collaboration**: one-click PDF/PPT/Excel export, integrated with the client's existing workflows.
6. **Training & iteration**: deliver usage documentation and iterate as the business changes.

---

## Our Advantages

- ✅ **Automotive industry know-how**: deep experience in passenger vehicle new-energy and overall sales data at the city/province dimension.
- ✅ **AI implementation capability**: more than drawing charts — we use AI for root-cause analysis, forecasting, and opportunity mining.
- ✅ **Low-barrier onboarding**: start from the client's existing Excel, lowering migration cost and learning curve.
- ✅ **Compliance and control**: permissions and calibers are controllable throughout.

# Special-purpose Vehicle Monthly Sales

## Use Cases

- **Segment monitoring**: observe special-purpose vehicle demand changes by month, region, and model.
- **Regional channel management**: compare sales performance across provinces and cities to support dealer network layout and target breakdown.
- **Competitor and product planning**: analyze brand, series, and powertrain market performance to assist model planning.
- **Inventory and business forecasting**: optimize production and sales arrangements in combination with internal order, delivery, and inventory data.

```json
[
    {
        "year": 2024,
        "month": 2,
```

# Vehicle Ownership Transfer Count Query

## Use Cases

- **Used car valuation and transaction decisions**: judge vehicle transfer frequency to assist pricing, acquisition, and sale.
- **Condition and risk verification**: identify potential risks such as frequent transfers and short-term flipping.
- **Insurance and finance review**: assist insurance underwriting, auto-loan approval, and risk assessment.

## Endpoint

`POST /api/v1/getVehTransferCount`

See the cooperation email notification for the endpoint.

## Request Parameters



Request headers: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`, `Content-Type: application/json`.

```json
{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN000001"}
```

`vin` is required and must be a 17-character VIN. Do not add other fields to the request body.

## Response Fields

### Common Response Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | Business status code: `0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` parameter format error, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Not used when the authentication layer rejects. |
| message | string | Business processing result description, returned by the service on success, no-data, or failure. |
| data | object/array/null | Business result. An object or array on success; usually null on no-data or business failure. |
| request_id | string | Request trace ID for troubleshooting; do not use it as a substitute for a key or token. |

### `data` Fields

| Field            | Type     | Meaning                              |
| ------------- | ------ | --------------------------------- |
| vin           | string | The VIN of the queried vehicle.                        |
| transferCount | string | Historical vehicle ownership-transfer count; returned as a string, `"0"` is a valid zero-transfer result. |

## Examples

### Free Test Case

Uses the current Swagger default input: `vin=1HGBH41JXMN000001`.

```bash
curl -X POST \
  "https://<API_HOST>/api/v1/getVehTransferCount" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN000001"}'
```

### Success Response

The following is the field-structure example based on the default test input; the count is for illustration only, and the actual result is subject to the interface response.

```json
{
  "code":"0000",
  "message":"成功",
  "data":{"vin":"1HGBH41JXMN00****","transferCount":"0"},
  "request_id":"request-id"
}
```

`transferCount` uses a string; `"0"` is a valid result and must not be treated as no-data.

## Error Codes

### Business Codes & Notes

`0000` success, `0001` no data, `4001` VIN format incorrect, `5001` service processing failure, `5002` supplier token acquisition failure. Authentication-layer errors are handled per the common authentication documentation.

### VIN Format Error (HTTP 400)

```json
{"code":"4001","message":"VIN格式不正确","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

### No Data, Service Failure, and Token Failure (HTTP 200)

```json
{"code":"0001","message":"查无数据","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5001","message":"供应商接口调用失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

```json
{"code":"5002","message":"供应商Token获取失败","data":null,"request_id":"request-id"}
```

Authentication-layer errors are HTTP `401`, `403`, `429`, `503` and do not use business codes.

---

# Transaction Volume, Age, Mileage & Transaction Price

## Use Cases

- **Used car pricing and valuation**: build a price reference for comparable vehicles by combining vehicle age, mileage, and transaction price.
- **Acquisition and inventory grading**: identify transaction activity across age-mileage combinations to assist acquisition decisions.
- **Regional business analysis**: compare transaction volume and price differences across provinces and cities to support channel layout.
- **Finance residual value and risk assessment**: provide market evidence for loan terms, financing amounts, and residual value estimation.

```json
[
    {
        "year_month": 202402,
        "province": "河南",
        "city": "濮阳",
        "brand": "奔驰",
        "series": "奔驰GLC级",
        "vehicle_class": "Mid-size SUV",
        "model": "2022款 奔驰GLC级 GLC 300 L 4MATIC 豪华型",
        "volume": 1,
        "average_price": 41,
        "average_age": 1.0833,
        "average_mileage": 0.6,
        "msrp": 47.53,
        "is_new_energy": "No"
    },
    {
        "year_month": 202402,
        "province": "河南",
        "city": "濮阳",
        "brand": "广汽埃安",
        "series": "AION Y",
        "vehicle_class": "Compact SUV",
        "model": "2022款 AION Y 70 智领版 磷酸铁锂",
        "volume": 1,
        "average_price": 9.6,
        "average_age": 1.9167,
        "average_mileage": 1.5,
        "msrp": 14.76,
        "is_new_energy": "Yes"
    }
]
```

- **Used car market flow analysis**: count transaction scale and cross-province/city vehicle flow to identify active markets.
- **Inventory and channel allocation**: optimize acquisition channels, inventory allocation, and logistics based on inflow/outflow direction.
- **Regional pricing and business planning**: compare supply-demand and transaction characteristics across cities to assist pricing and store layout.
- **Cross-regional marketing and risk control**: identify cross-region transaction opportunities and abnormal flows to support marketing and manual verification.

# Used Car Value Retention Rate

## Use Cases

- **Used car valuation and pricing**: compare value retention levels by brand, model, and vehicle age to support acquisition pricing.
- **New car product and finance design**: assess model residual value performance to inform pricing, financing terms, and leasing plans.
- **Inventory and replacement management**: identify models with better value retention to optimize inventory structure and replacement strategy.
- **Consumer purchase decisions**: provide a reference for vehicle selection, long-term holding cost, and future resale expectations.

```json
[
    {
        "year_month": 202602,
        "brand": "比亚迪",
        "manufacturer": "比亚迪",
        "series": "比亚迪E2",
        "sub_series": "比亚迪E2",
        "vehicle_type": "Sedan",
        "body_type": "Hatchback",
        "vehicle_class": "Compact sedan",
        "brand_attribute": "Non-luxury",
        "brand_origin": "Domestic",
        "manufacturer_type": "Domestic",
        "vehicle_age": 3,
        "value_retention_rate": 0.5253
    }
]
```

The table below uses the same record as the JSON example above, with fields laid out by column for easy viewing and copying in spreadsheet form.

| 202602 | 比亚迪 | 比亚迪 | 比亚迪E2 | 比亚迪E2 | Sedan   | Hatchback   | Compact sedan | Non-luxury  | Domestic   | Domestic   |   3 | 0.5253 |

# Valuation - GetUsedPriceMileAgeCity

## Use Cases

- **Acquisition and transaction pricing**: generate a valuation reference by combining factors such as vehicle age, mileage, and city.
- **Inventory grading and negotiation**: provide a unified baseline for acquisition quotes, inventory pricing, and manual negotiation.
- **Finance and lease residual assessment**: assist in determining financing amount, term, and risk buffer.
- **Customer quoting and explanation**: explain price differences with structured factors to improve quote transparency.



## Endpoint

See the cooperation email notification.

## API Description

| Protocol | Method | Encoding | Response Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HTTPS | GET/POST | UTF-8 | JSON |

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| access_token | string | Yes | Access token; only required when signature verification is enabled. Generate it via the App.Auth.ApplyToken interface |
| model_id | string | Yes | Trim ID / model ID |
| type | integer | Yes | Usage type: 1 non-operational, 2 operational, 3 leased non-operational, 4 leased operational, 5 operational-to-non (8 years), 6 ride-hailing taxi, 7 ride-hailing-taxi-to-non, 8 operational-to-non (15 years) |
| condition | integer | Yes | Vehicle condition: 1 excellent, 2 good, 3 fair, 4 poor, 5 very poor |
| mile | float | Yes | Mileage (in 10,000 km, must not be 0), up to two decimals, e.g., 20.60 |
| city | string | Yes | City, e.g., 东莞 |
| licensing_date | string | Yes | Registration date, format: YYYY-MM-DD, e.g., 2022-01-01 |
| register_type | integer | Optional | Owner type, 1 individual, 2 company |
| transfer_count | integer | Optional | Number of vehicle ownership transfers |
| color | enum | Optional | Color: white, red, black, silver, gray, other |



## Response Fields

### Response Result

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ret | integer | Status code; 200 = success, 4xx = client error, 5xx = server error |
| data | object or mixed type | Business data, specified per interface; usually an object |
| msg | string | Message; error description on failure |

## Examples

### Sample Data

```text
// Successful response example
{
    "ret": 200,
    "data": {
        "BuyPrice": "2.84", // Used car acquisition price (RMB 10,000)
        "ModelID": "17650", // Trim ID returned
        "SellPrice": "3.27" // Used car sale price (RMB 10,000)
    },
    "msg": ""
}

// Failed query example, parameter error
{
    "ret": 400,
    "data": {},
    "msg": "VIN位数不合规"
}

// Failed query example, no data
{
    "ret": 414,
    "data": {},
    "msg": "查无数据"
}
```

## Error Codes

### Error List

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | ret=400, client parameter error or invalid request |
| 404 | ret=404, the interface service does not exist |
| 406 | ret=406, access_token verification failed |
| 407 | ret=407, insufficient app_key permission or unknown application |
| 408 | ret=408, the current user is prohibited or not logged in |
| 414 | ret=414, no data found |
| 500 | Internal server error |

# VIN Model Lookup (High Precision) - GetModelByVIN

## Use Cases

- **Vehicle profile completion**: match brand, series, model, and configuration through the VIN to reduce manual data entry.
- **Used car valuation and acquisition screening**: after confirming the exact trim, assist in matching MSRP, condition, and historical transaction data.
- **Finance and insurance verification**: provide standardized model base information for auto loans, insurance quoting, and risk rules.
- **Repair and parts matching**: confirm the exact model to determine maintenance, repair, and parts applicability.
- **Data governance and manual review**: trigger a review when registration data disagrees with VIN lookup results.

## Endpoint

See the cooperation email notification.

## API Description

| Protocol | Method | Encoding | Response Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HTTPS | GET/POST | UTF-8 | JSON |

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| access_token | string | Yes | Access token; generate it via the App.Auth.ApplyToken interface |
| vin | string | Yes | Min: 17; Max: 17. The VIN, e.g., 1HGBH41JXMN000001 |

## Response Fields

### Response Result

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ret | integer | Status code; 200 = success, 4xx = client error, 5xx = server error |
| data | object or mixed type | Business data, specified per interface; usually an object |
| msg | string | Message; error description on failure |

### Data Array Field Meanings

| Field        | Data Type  | Meaning                     | Example                              |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| vin        | varchar | The VIN from the request                 |                                   |
| autoID     | int     | AUTODATA model-library trim ID; blank marks 0 | 26847                             |
| bodyStruct | varchar | Body structure                      | SUV                               |
| chexi      | varchar | Series                        | 自由侠(第一代,2016-)                    |
| chexing    | varchar | Model / trim                      | 自由侠 2016款 1.4T 手动动能版              |
| clxh       | varchar | Vehicle model                      | GFA7140DFCA                       |
| code       | varchar | Trim code                     | 8LR3UFIUC25V7O86 S200089M31708581 |
| code5      | varchar | One-to-one relationship between code5 and chexi | 8LR3UF                            |
| csys       | varchar | Body color                      | 皓白色                               |
| edzk       | varchar | Rated seating                     | 5                                 |
| fdjhm      | varchar | Engine number                    | 200991                            |
| fdjMod     | varchar | Engine                      | 1.4T 150马力 L4                     |
| fdjxh      | varchar | Engine model                    | 523A0027                          |
| gl         | varchar | Power                        | 110                               |
| hlj        | varchar | Rear track                      | 1540                              |
| jiage      | decimal | MSRP                      | 13.48                             |
| jibie      | varchar | Vehicle class                      | 小型SUV                             |
| ltgg       | varchar | Tire specification                      | 215\/65R16 98H                    |
| lts        | varchar | Number of tires                     | 4                                 |
| niank      | int     | Model year                       | 2016                              |
| oilWay     | varchar | Fuel type                      | 汽油                                |
| pfbz       | varchar | Emission standard                      | GB18352.5-2013国V                  |
| qlj        | varchar | Front track                      | 1540                              |
